capabilities: Pin files from the command palette or File Explorer context menu
Open pinned files from a compact sidebar view
Reorder pinned rows by drag and drop
Show pin indicators on matching files in the File Explorer
List pinned files on the new tab page
disambiguation: Not a bookmarks replacement; it keeps its own pin list and does not use bookmarks or frontmatter as the source of truth.
extras: Stable at v1.2.1; syncs its pin list via Obsidian Sync by periodically reloading its own data.json. Manual installation requires copying manifest.json, main.js, and styles.css from GitHub releases.
intentEvidence: It does not replace or rebuild Obsidian's File Explorer.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated compact sidebar list for always-visible quick access to a few important files.
summary: Sidebar view that pins important files for one-click access, with pin indicators in the File Explorer and optional pins on new tabs.
